description: Java class EntityFieldMap representing a condition expression for a collection of field comparisons, used in building query conditions within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityFieldMap
classes.description: Final class extending EntityConditionListBase, representing a collection of field comparison conditions with methods to access and iterate over the field map.

methods.name: makeConditionList
methods.description: Converts a map of fields into a list of EntityExpr conditions using a specified comparison operator.

methods.name: EntityFieldMap
methods.description: Constructor that creates an EntityFieldMap from a list of key-value pairs, comparison operator, and join operator.

methods.name: EntityFieldMap
methods.description: Constructor that creates an EntityFieldMap from a map of fields, comparison operator, and join operator.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given field name.

methods.name: containsField
methods.description: Checks if a specific field name exists in the field map.

methods.name: getFieldKeyIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the field names in the map.

methods.name: getFieldEntryIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the entries (field name and value pairs) in the map.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing EntityConditionVisitor to process this condition.
